ingredients.name: mandarin oranges, 11 ounces each, drained, juice saved
mandarin orange juice, saved from the oranges
chicken breast, cooked and cut into chunks

steps.instruction: Drain 2 cans of mandarin oranges and save the juice.
Whisk 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Whisk in 3 tablespoons of mandarin orange juice and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.
Cook the instant brown rice by the package directions to make 3 cups.
Place 3 1/3 cups of trimmed asparagus in a large skillet with 1 1/2 inches of water.
Bring the water to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer the asparagus, uncovered, for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat and simmer the asparagus, uncovered, for 2 to five minutes.

steps.instruction: Rinse the asparagus with cool water.
Cut the asparagus into 1-inch pieces.
Toss the asparagus, oranges, 12 ounces of chicken breast, rice and dressing in a bowl.

ingredients.name: Granny Smith apple, rinsed and sliced thinly with the skin on
mixed lettuce greens, about 5 cups, rinsed

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of lemon juice on the apple slices.
Mix 1 bag of mixed lettuce greens and 1/2 cup of dried cranberries in a bowl.
Add the apple, 1/4 cup of chopped walnuts and 1/4 cup of sunflower seeds.
Toss with 1/3 cup of vinaigrette dressing to lightly cover the salad.
Serve.

baked-salmon-with-herbs-and-lemon.title: Baked Salmon with Herbs and Lemon

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Spicy Baked Fish, Pumpkin Post and Banana Beat Newsletters, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: salmon, fresh or frozen (or any white fish)

steps.instruction: If the fish is frozen, thaw it in the refrigerator.
steps.spoken: If the fish is frozen, thaw it in the refrigerator, following the package directions.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Cut 16 ounces of salmon into 4 pieces.
Place the salmon in a 13x9x2-inch baking pan.
Mix 1/4 teaspoon each of paprika, onion powder and garlic powder in a small bowl.
Mix in 1/8 teaspoon each of black pepper, oregano and thyme.
Sprinkle the herb mixture evenly over the salmon.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of lemon juice evenly over the salmon.
Drizzle 1 1/2 tablespoons of melted margarine on top.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-five minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup flour, 1 tablespoon sugar and 2 teaspoons baking powder in a large bowl.
Add a little bit of salt to the bowl.
Whisk 1 cup of milk and 1 egg into the flour mixture.
steps.spoken: Whisk 1 cup of milk and 1 egg into the flour mixture. Whisk the milk and the egg into the flour mixture until no clumps remain in the batter.

steps.instruction: Mix 2 mashed bananas into the batter.
Melt some butter in a medium frying pan over medium heat.
Pour batter into the pan to make a pancake, smaller or bigger as you like.
Cook 2 minutes, until tiny air bubbles form on top.
steps.spoken: Wait until tiny air bubbles form on top. This takes 2 to five minutes.

steps.instruction: Turn the pancake and fry until the bottom is browned.
Repeat with the rest of the batter.
Mix 1/3 cup of oatmeal and 1/8 teaspoon of salt in a microwave-safe cereal bowl.
Stir in 3/4 cup of water.
Microwave on high power for 1 minute.
Stir the oatmeal.
Microwave on high power for 1 more minute.
Stir the oatmeal again.
Microwave on high power for 30 more seconds.
steps.spoken: Microwave on high power for 30 to sixty more seconds, until the oatmeal is as thick as you like.

steps.instruction: Stir the oatmeal once more.
Top with 1/2 sliced banana and 1/2 cup of frozen yogurt.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil, or cooking oil of choice
green or red bell pepper, chopped, optional
mushrooms, sliced (or 4 ounce can mushrooms, drained)
low-sodium bouillon, vegetable, beef or chicken

steps.instruction: Place a medium pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, 1 cup of chopped onion and 1/2 cup of celery.
Cook, stirring often, until the onion is soft.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped bell pepper, if you are using it.
Add 1 cup of sliced mushrooms and 1 cup of pearl barley.
Stir everything well.
Add 2 1/2 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of bouillon.
Stir to dissolve the bouillon.
Bring the pan to a boil.
Lower the heat and cover the pan.
Cook for 50 minutes, until the barley is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
steps.spoken: Cook for 50 to sixty minutes, until the barley is tender and the liquid is absorbed.

ingredients.name: nuts, chopped, such as almonds or pumpkin seeds
dried fruit, such as apricots, unsweetened cranberries or dates

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 315 °F.
Mix 3 cups of oats, 1/2 cup of olive oil and 1/2 cup of maple syrup in a large bowl.
Stir in 1 cup of chopped nuts, 1 teaspoon of cloves and 1 teaspoon of cardamom.
Cover two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Spread the mixture thinly and evenly on the sheets and put them in the oven.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Take the sheets out, stir the mixture and swap the sheets' oven places.
steps.spoken: Take the sheets out, stir the mixture, and put them back in the oven. Swap their places for even cooking.

steps.instruction: Bake for 15 minutes.
Take the sheets out, stir again and swap the sheets' oven places.
steps.spoken: Take the sheets out, stir the mixture, and put them back in the oven. Swap their places for even cooking.

steps.instruction: Bake for 10 minutes.
Take the sheets out and let the granola cool without stirring.
steps.spoken: Take the sheets out and do not stir. Leaving it alone helps it form clumps. Let it cool.

steps.instruction: Chop 1 cup of dried fruit coarsely and mix it in.

ingredients.name: tomatoes, cut into wedges or slices
black olives, pitted and coarsely chopped

steps.instruction: Put 2 cups of lettuce and 4 cut tomatoes in a large bowl.
Add 1 sliced cucumber, 1 sliced bell pepper and 1 small sliced onion.
Add 1/2 cup of coarsely chopped black olives.
In a small bowl, whisk 6 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 teaspoon of red wine vinegar.
Whisk in 1/2 teaspoon of garlic, 1/2 teaspoon of oregano and 1/2 teaspoon of dill weed.
Whisk in 1/4 cup of parsley, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad.
Sprinkle 3/5 cup of crumbled feta cheese on top.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Deliciously Healthy Family Meals

ingredients.name: chicken breast, boneless and skinless, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.instruction: Preheat a broiler or grill on medium-high heat.
Thread 3 chicken breast cubes and 3 pineapple chunks onto each of the 8 skewers.
Stir 2 tablespoons each of ketchup, lite soy sauce and honey together in a bowl.
Stir in 2 teaspoons of orange juice, 1 teaspoon of garlic and 1 teaspoon of ginger.
Divide the sauce between two bowls and set one bowl aside for later.
Grill the skewers for 3 minutes on one side.
steps.spoken: Grill the skewers for 3 to five minutes on one side.

steps.instruction: Brush the skewers with sauce from the first bowl as they grill.
steps.spoken: Brush the chicken and pineapple with sauce from the first bowl about every other minute.

steps.instruction: Flip the skewers and grill them for 3 minutes on the other side.
steps.spoken: Flip the skewers and grill them for 3 to five minutes on the other side.

steps.instruction: Throw away the sauce left in the first bowl.
Finish the skewers in a 350 °F oven until a thermometer reads 165 °F.
steps.spoken: Right away, finish the skewers in a 350 °F oven, until a thermometer reads 165 °F inside the chicken. This keeps the chicken from drying out.

steps.instruction: Coat the skewers with the saved sauce, using a clean brush or spoon.
Mix 1 cup of milk and 1 cup of sugar in a medium bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Mix in 1 pint of heavy cream and 2 tablespoons of vanilla extract.
Stir in 1/2 cup of honey.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Add it to an ice cream maker and run it for 30 minutes.
Quickly scoop the ice cream out of the maker into a container.
steps.spoken: Quickly scoop the ice cream out of the maker into a container. A silicone spatula helps, because it lets you scrape down the sides.

steps.instruction: Freeze the ice cream overnight.
steps.spoken: Freeze the ice cream overnight. A few hours will do in a pinch, but overnight is better.

steps.instruction: Scoop the ice cream out of the container and serve.
steps.spoken: Scoop the ice cream out of the container and serve. This makes 8 to ten servings.

steps.instruction: Put 3 cups of red lentils and 12 cups of water in a large pot.
Set the pot on medium heat and cook the lentils for 8 minutes.
steps.spoken: Set the pot on medium heat and bring it to a boil. After the lentils have cooked about 8 minutes, add the onion and chard mixture.

steps.instruction: In a pan, saute 1 large diced red onion for 5 minutes, until pink.
Add 4 cups of chopped Swiss chard to the onion.
steps.spoken: Add 4 cups of chopped Swiss chard to the onion. Add the chopped Swiss chard to the onion in the pan. Saute together for 2 to three minutes, until the chard is wilted.

steps.instruction: Add the onion and chard mixture to the boiling lentils.
Add 2 small diced Yukon gold potatoes and 1 medium diced zucchini to the pot.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Lower the heat to medium-low, cover the pot and cook for 12 minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat to medium-low, cover the pot and cook for about 12 minutes, until the potatoes and lentils are tender.

steps.instruction: Add 1 bunch of chopped cilantro, then stir and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 bunch of chopped cilantro, then stir and cook for 5 minutes. Stir and cook for about 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/4 cup of lemon juice and 1 teaspoon of cumin before serving.
Pour 2 fluid ounces of whiskey into a mixing glass with ice.
Add 1 fluid ounce of sweet vermouth and 2 to 3 dashes of bitters.
Stir the drink in the mixing glass.
Strain the drink into a coupe glass.
Garnish with a cherry or lemon twist, if you like.
Mix 2 eggs, 3 tablespoons of sugar, 1 tablespoon of honey and 4 tablespoons of milk.
steps.spoken: Mix 2 eggs, 3 tablespoons of sugar, 1 tablespoon of honey and 4 tablespoons of milk. You can use water instead of milk.

steps.instruction: In another bowl, mix 1 cup of oat flour and 1 teaspoon of baking powder.
Combine the two mixtures, then let the batter rest for 15 minutes.
Preheat a pan over low heat for 5 minutes.
Pour batter into the pan to make one pancake.
steps.spoken: Pour batter into the pan to make one pancake. Cook for 1 to 1 and a half minutes, until bubbles come up.

steps.instruction: Flip the pancake and cook for 1 more minute.
steps.spoken: Flip the pancake once you see bubbles, and cook for 1 more minute.

steps.instruction: Top the pancakes with raspberry jam, if you like.

ingredients.name: short pasta, such as fusilli or penne

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the hot pan and wait a couple of minutes.
Add 10 to 14 ounces of ground beef and salt, and mix with the onion.
When the beef is almost cooked, mince 2 to 3 cloves of garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika to the pan.
Cook 8 ounces of pasta in a pot until firm to the bite, while the beef cooks.
Grate 3 to 4 tomatoes over the pan on a fine grater, so the juice falls in.
Grate 1 carrot on a medium grater and add it to the pan.
Add more salt and black pepper to taste, and mix.
Cook over medium to medium-low heat for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium to medium-low heat for 10 to fifteen minutes, until the tomato juices have almost completely cooked away.

steps.instruction: Add the cooked pasta to the pan and cook for a couple of minutes.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Deliciously Healthy Family Meals

ingredients.name: chicken breast, grilled, boneless, skinless and diced (about 2 small breasts)
fresh basil, rinsed, dried and chopped (or 1 teaspoon dried)

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven or toaster oven to 450 °F.
Spread 1/4 cup of tomato sauce on each of the 4 pitas.
Top each pita with 1/4 cup of diced chicken breast and 1/4 cup of broccoli.
Top each pita with 1/2 tablespoon of parmesan cheese and 1/4 tablespoon of basil.
Place the pitas on a nonstick baking sheet.
Bake for 5 minutes, until golden brown and the chicken is heated through.
steps.spoken: Bake for 5 to eight minutes, until the pitas are golden brown and the chicken is heated through.

steps.instruction: Serve right away.
Cut 3 1/2 ounces of bacon into bits.
Sauté the bacon until it is well browned.
Peel 1 pound of potatoes and dice them into small chunks.
Peel and slice 10 ounces of carrots.
Boil the potatoes and carrots in salted water for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Boil the potatoes and carrots in salted water for 20 to twenty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes and carrots.
Mash the potatoes and carrots with a fork.
steps.spoken: Mash them with a fork so that the texture stays slightly chunky.

steps.instruction: Mix in the bacon bits and 3 1/2 tablespoons of butter.
Mix in 7 tablespoons of heavy cream and 1/2 teaspoon of ground nutmeg.
Season with salt and pepper.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style

steps.instruction: Put 1 cup of yogurt, 6 medium strawberries and 1 medium banana in a blender.
Add 1 cup of crushed pineapple, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 4 ice cubes.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into frosted glasses.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans

steps.instruction: Place 3 cups of zucchini chunks in a microwave-safe 2-quart dish.
Add 1 small sliced onion and 1 medium diced tomato to the dish.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped mushrooms and 1/2 teaspoon of dried basil.
Microwave on high for 7 minutes, until the vegetables are fork tender.
steps.spoken: Microwave on high for 7 to ten minutes, or until the vegetables are tender when poked with a fork.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Microwave on high for 30 seconds.
Let the dish stand 2 minutes before serving.
steps.spoken: Let the dish stand for 2 to three minutes before serving.
